$comment: Project knowledge only. Anything here that every project would copy verbatim belongs in orch instead.

gate.$comment: Files that matter for the diff gate. Contents are hashed, not mtimes. Exclude anything whose change should not trigger verification.

scheduler.$comment: Let the daemon auto-dispatch todo tasks itself (hitl: false only). maxConcurrent caps how many task agents run in this project at once. Edit with `orch project scheduler <n>`; only the committed copy on the base branch applies.
